target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents and products that need structured web data
problem: Agents need clean, fresh data from arbitrary websites. Teams otherwise stitch together scrapers, crawlers, search and enrichment services.
business_model: Usage-based API with credit tiers from free to 950 dollars a month plus enterprise
product_category: Web data and context API for AI agents

founders.name: Yahia Bakour
prior_employers: Amazon (SDE2, tech lead on a retail checkout platform)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Firecrawl
competitors.what: Crawl, scrape and search API for AI agents
competitors.traction_then: named top pick in its own 2026 guide
competitors.funding_then: a listing cites a 14.5M dollar Series A (date unclear)

competitors.name: Exa
competitors.what: Embeddings based semantic search API for machines

competitors.name: Tavily
competitors.what: Search and retrieval API for AI applications

competitors.name: Parallel
competitors.what: Web API for agents focused on search, deep research and enrichment

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable scraping at scale, anti bot handling, structured extraction and monitoring are standard but operationally heavy engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded rivals sell similar APIs and roundups list at least ten alternatives. Brand and company data from the original Brand.dev product gives some data depth.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals kept shipping search and extraction features through 2026. No acquisition of Context.dev found.

market_need_then: AI agent builders need live web data. The company reports more than 800 customers on its YC page and names Mintlify, Klarna and others, which are self reported claims.

branding.name_origin: Renamed from Brand.dev because the product grew from brand data into a full web context layer, per the founder's launch post as summarized by search results. The name Context describes what the product delivers.
branding.domain_note: Moved to context.dev around March 2026 from brand.dev; purchase details not found.

rebrands.why: Product outgrew brand data and became a web context layer; one profile gives March 21 and another March 22, 2026.

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt and Hacker News as Launch HN Context.dev (YC S26). A post titled We are Context.dev, not Context.ai suggests confusion with similarly named Context companies.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear developer facing name with a recent rebrand and visible launches, but generic and confusable with other Context companies.

pivots.from: Brand data API (logos, colors, fonts, company info)
pivots.to: Unified web context API for AI agents
pivots.why: Expanded from brand data into scraping, search, enrichment and monitoring for agents.

outcome_analysis: Brand.dev widened into Context.dev in March 2026 as agent builders needed web data, joined YC Summer 2026 and announced a 9 million dollar round led by General Catalyst in October 2026. Strengths are a timely market and a repeat founder with an earlier acquired startup. The risk is a crowded field of funded web data APIs for agents.
notes: Round type and valuation not disclosed. A launch email reportedly lists Eniac and an aggregator lists Pioneer Fund, both unverified and not recorded. Team size is 6 on the YC profile but 4 in the launch post. Launch dates conflict between Product Hunt (July 2) and a news site (August 5). Context (AI office suite) is a different company.
